## Detail

Emmanuel Mayowa Samuel is an AI/ML Engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria, working remotely and
open to remote roles in the US and EU.

Current work:
- ThreadChain (May 2026 - present), AI/ML and Full-Stack Engineer. Builds the Google Gemini
  orchestration behind an AI design-specification generator for fashion brands, plus per-call
  AI cost metering, a centralised model-call retry layer, Stripe credit billing, and an
  OpenTelemetry observability stack.
- Metcore Digital Technologies (Sep 2025 - present), AI/ML Engineer. Architected LangGraph
  agents on AWS Bedrock AgentCore across 7 product lines, loading tool catalogues at runtime
  over the Model Context Protocol. Shipped agents across three delivery channels: voice on
  LiveKit with Amazon Nova Sonic, a per-tenant REST API, and an embeddable widget. Built an
  AIOps operator console integrating six monitoring systems with anomaly detection,
  forecasting and root-cause ranking.

Previously:
- Legal Action Media (Jul 2025 - May 2026), AI and Full-Stack Engineer on contract, owning the
  AI layer for a US personal-injury law firm's product suite.
- Egbin Power Plc (Jul 2024 - Jul 2025), Industrial Engineering Intern during Nigeria's
  national youth service, building internal tooling that cut OPEX report preparation from one
  week to two days and cleared a ticket backlog across a 430-bed estate serving 500+ staff.

Education: B.Eng. Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Federal University of Technology, Minna
(2018-2023). Udacity Machine Learning Fundamentals and AI Programming with Python nanodegrees.

Core technologies: Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, LangChain, Model Context Protocol, AWS
Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, FastAPI, NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Celery, BullMQ,
Docker, OpenTelemetry, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost.
